title: Align the CI verification workflow with the retired browser runtime
summary: .github/workflows/verification.yml still installs -e packages/assayer-provider-browser in the fast and full jobs and runs `python -m playwright install --with-deps chrome` in the full job. The provider-browser package was deleted in b5921f9 and remove-browser-runtime-and-playwright removed Playwright from the dependency graph, so both jobs fail before running any test. No design record covers .github/**, and remove-browser-runtime-and-playwright is implemented and immutable, so this needs its own record. The fix removes the two provider-browser install lines and the Playwright install step, leaving the rest of the workflow unchanged. No public contract, artifact, or test behavior changes; CI is only made consistent with the already-approved browser removal. CI is release behavior, which contract §3/§4 lists as a human-approval trigger, so the record is classified `compatible` rather than `internal_only` and carries an explicit human approval.

platform: The platform owns the CI verification workflow and its dependency install set
provider: The workflow stops installing the already-deleted browser provider; the markdown provider stays

forbiddenResponsibilities: The workflow must not reintroduce the browser provider or Playwright without a new approved browser capability record
The change must not weaken the fast, full, or install-matrix jobs beyond removing the retired browser steps
acceptance: The fast and full jobs no longer reference packages/assayer-provider-browser
The full job no longer installs Playwright or Chromium
The workflow still installs the markdown provider, the SDK, and the test extra
scripts/run_tests.py fast and full pass locally without a browser

humanApproval.decision: User replied '删并 push' in #assayer-group:4c84ee19, approving removal of the retired provider-browser install lines and the Playwright install step in the CI workflow and authorizing the push.
